data.content_ref: inline:Allow a user-supplied total preorder on attack edges, and define a strengthened grounded extension by deleting an attack edge if its target has an accepted defender with a higher-priority attack on the attacker. If the preorder is acyclic (e.g., derived from a deterministic timestamp), the deletion process is confluent and polynomial, and the resulting extension contains the original grounded extension. Reinstatement is then a derived property of the priority-deleted subgraph. Criticism: preferences are not part of the original specification and may make the semantics non-argumentative; also need to show that the original grounded extension is preserved in all cases.
